subtitle: 5 questions in real GRE format. A new quiz on this week's words goes live every Sunday.
instructions: You have 45 seconds per question; the quiz moves on when time runs out.
Your score appears the moment you finish.
Sentence Equivalence: choose exactly two answers that give the sentence the same meaning.

questions.prompt: Although the preliminary geological findings were hailed as groundbreaking, subsequent longitudinal surveys proved that the initial seismic anomalies were merely ________, dissipating before any permanent faultline could be verified.
questions.explanation: 'Ephemeral' (lasting for a brief time / transitory) perfectly matches the context of seismic anomalies that 'dissipated before any permanent faultline could be verified.' The contrast word 'Although' contrasts the hailed 'groundbreaking' status with their fleeting reality.
questions.label: Text Completion

questions.prompt: The dean praised the visiting physicist for her ability to render extraordinarily complex quantum electrodynamics into ________ lectures that captivated both undergraduate freshmen and senior faculty alike.
questions.explanation: The lectures 'captivated both undergraduate freshmen and senior faculty', so despite the complex subject they must have been clear: 'lucid' and 'pellucid' both mean easy to understand. 'Abstruse' and 'esoteric' are the trap pair: they are synonyms of each other, but they mean hard to understand, the opposite of what the sentence needs.
questions.label: Sentence Equivalence

questions.prompt: Rejecting the purely theoretical musings of earlier socio-political treatises, the new commission took a resolutely ________ stance, enacting only policies supported by quantifiable municipal data.
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' (dealing with things sensibly and practically based on real-world results rather than theory) directly contrasts with 'purely theoretical musings' and aligns with 'quantifiable municipal data'.
questions.label: Text Completion

questions.prompt: Once restricted to secretive medieval guilds, the alchemical formulas that scholars once dismissed as hopelessly ________ have now been decoded and contextualized by modern historians of science.
questions.explanation: 'Esoteric' refers to knowledge intended for or understood by only a small, specialized, initiated inner circle — in this case, 'secretive medieval guilds'.
questions.label: Text Completion

questions.prompt: While smartphone notifications have become ________ in contemporary urban life, cognitive scientists caution that this constant sensory bombardment degrades sustained academic attention spans.
questions.explanation: 'Constant sensory bombardment' tells you notifications are everywhere: 'ubiquitous' and 'omnipresent' both mean that. 'Infrequent' and 'sporadic' are the trap pair: they mean the same as each other, but they contradict 'constant'.
questions.label: Sentence Equivalence
